## Submitting an Access Request via the ISC API

Use the **POST /v3/access-requests** endpoint to request that a user be granted an access profile, role, or entitlement.

### Request

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/access-requests
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
Content-Type: application/json
```

```json
{
  "requestedFor": ["2c9180858082150f0180893dbaf44201"],
  "requestType": "GRANT_ACCESS",
  "requestedItems": [
    {
      "type": "ACCESS_PROFILE",
      "id": "2c9180858082150f0180893dbaf99999",
      "comment": "Needed for Q3 project access"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Key fields

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `requestedFor` | Array of **identity IDs** (not usernames) to grant access to |
| `requestType` | `GRANT_ACCESS` or `REVOKE_ACCESS` |
| `requestedItems[].type` | `ACCESS_PROFILE`, `ROLE`, or `ENTITLEMENT` |
| `requestedItems[].id` | The ID of the specific access item |
| `requestedItems[].comment` | Optional justification/reason |
| `requestedItems[].removeDate` | Optional ISO-8601 date for time-limited access (e.g. `"2026-12-31T00:00:00Z"`) |

### Auth

You need a client credentials OAuth2 token with the `idn:access-request:create` scope:

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/oauth/token
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

grant_type=client_credentials&client_id={client_id}&client_secret={client_secret}
```

### Example with curl

```bash
curl -X POST "https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/access-requests" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "requestedFor": ["2c9180858082150f0180893dbaf44201"],
    "requestType": "GRANT_ACCESS",
    "requestedItems": [
      {
        "type": "ACCESS_PROFILE",
        "id": "2c9180858082150f0180893dbaf99999",
        "comment": "Project access request"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

### Finding IDs

If you don't know the identity or access item IDs, look them up first:

```bash
# Find identity ID by name/attribute
GET /v3/identities?filters=name eq "John Smith"

# Find access profile ID by name
GET /v3/access-profiles?filters=name eq "My Access Profile"

# Find role ID
GET /v3/roles?filters=name eq "My Role"
```

A successful submission returns `202 Accepted` with no body — the request enters the approval workflow if one is configured.

```answer-summary
endpoints:
  - method: POST
    path: /v3/access-requests
    api_version: v3
  - method: GET
    path: /v3/identities
    api_version: v3
  - method: GET
    path: /v3/access-profiles
    api_version: v3
  - method: GET
    path: /v3/roles
    api_version: v3
  - method: POST
    path: /oauth/token
    api_version: oauth
auth_flow: OAuth2 bearer token (client credentials)
required_scopes: [idn:access-request:create]
key_parameters: [requestedFor, requestType, requestedItems, type, id, comment, removeDate]
```
